objective: Implement real independent Android Kotlin/Gradle native Godot host, native splash, keyboard GIF local content handling, and fail-closed release safeguards without touching BUKLOD main/staging or claiming full app completion.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source main was 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f, not installed runtime evidence. Main adds 7 commits covering consent, PTT, admin inbox, cluster check-in, AdMob retention and other fixes. They have NOT been forward-ported or proven in this incomplete native host; release remains blocked.
chosenApproach: Separate native-genesis/android host with Godot Android AAR and app-private PCK, native Android 12 splash and IME GIF handler. Full parity gate remains negative until verified. No changes to main app or Expo/EAS source; no cloud build.
selectionRationale: Godot officially documents GodotActivity embedding using org.godotengine:godot AAR and --main-pack. A separate Gradle-only project advances source migration and protects users from the crashing preview and wrong-package overwrite.
